{{Quote|If you mean Rhovari, that's too far. It'll be hard to distribute the medication from there.|Goll|<ref name="Mercy Mission" />}}
'''Rhovari''' was a [[city]] located to the west of [[Lessu City|Lessu]] on the [[planet]] [[Ryloth]]. During a [[Relief mission to Ryloth|mission]] to deliver [[gattis-root]] to [[Twi'lek]] elders, [[Krysiant Rheden]] asked if they could land at a fallback at Rhovari, [[Goll]] rejected the idea saying it was too far from Lessu and would make distributing medicine hard.<ref name="Mercy Mission" /> The Twi'lek [[Yendor Brethen]] was from the city, and after the exploits of fellow Twi'lek [[Hera Syndulla]] in the rebel [[Phoenix Cell]] reached Rhovari, Brethen was inspired to join the rebellion.<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>
